road.definition: Distances are measured from road centreline in the municipality's 2018 named-road list; not the visible asphalt edge.

Use classification confirmed by municipality (homestay might not equal private residence).

Reference manual; first determine actual road category and controlling highway/province rules.

horizontal.note: Rule 50(2): 2 m baseline with +0.305 m for each extra 33 kV; NEA to calculate actual line clearance including wind swing.

ground.note: Rule 48(3) adds 0.305 m per further 33 kV to the 33 kV schedule; NEA engineer must verify.

corridors.note: Only conductor clearance verified here, not a standard corridor width.

checklist.question: Verify original Lalpurja and current Shresta match the seller, parcel, share and area.
checklist.proof: Current certified Land Revenue Office ownership extract; original ID
checklist.warning: Seller not the recorded owner or share cannot be conveyed

checklist.question: Check Rokka, mortgage, court attachment, tenancy/Mohi and pending disputes.
checklist.proof: Written current restrictions and encumbrance check
checklist.warning: Unreleased hold, contested ownership or undisclosed tenure

checklist.question: Confirm all heirs, co-owners, spouses or authorized signatories required to sell.
checklist.proof: Consent, partition/inheritance papers or valid power of attorney
checklist.ask: Land lawyer and Land Revenue Office
checklist.warning: Agent alone offers land without proved power to transfer

checklist.question: Obtain tax clearance and have a property lawyer review the deed and transfer sequence.
checklist.proof: Tax receipt, draft deed, registration checklist
checklist.warning: Large payment demanded before official registration

checklist.question: Obtain certified cadastral/tracing map, Kitta and field book or plot register.
checklist.proof: Mero Kitta / Napi copies tied to same parcel
checklist.warning: Plot on map differs from Lalpurja or seller's outlined land

checklist.question: Commission boundary demarcation and survey actual area, shape and frontage.
checklist.proof: Measured boundaries with licensed surveyor and neighbor acknowledgement
checklist.warning: Physical overlap, encroachment or unexplained shortage

checklist.question: Reconcile Lalpurja, field book, survey result and road deduction before paying by area.
checklist.proof: Four-record area reconciliation and buildable area sketch
checklist.warning: Unresolved area mismatch or only a hand-drawn Google outline

checklist.question: Confirm actual rural municipality, ward and land-use class from the parcel record.
checklist.proof: Written jurisdiction and classification response
checklist.warning: Agricultural/restricted land proposed as freely buildable

checklist.question: Check whether a residential villa/cottage may get Naksa Pass and required setbacks.
checklist.proof: Written development control and permit feasibility
checklist.warning: Building cannot legally fit after setbacks or risk exclusions

checklist.question: Check subdivision limits, protected areas, public rights and future road widening.
checklist.proof: Approved layout and zoning/road plan
checklist.warning: Unapproved plotting or planned acquisition consumes buildable parcel

checklist.question: Trace the road continuously from public highway to the property and identify legal ownership.
checklist.proof: Survey map and public road classification or registered easement
checklist.warning: Access crosses private land without enforceable right

checklist.question: Measure actual approach and road frontage, turning radius and vehicle access.
checklist.proof: Surveyed width, grade and turning/parking assessment
checklist.warning: Emergency vehicle or construction delivery cannot reach site

checklist.question: Inspect the route during rain; check bridge, erosion and seasonal blockages.
checklist.proof: Wet-season route record and road maintenance responsibility
checklist.warning: Only dry-weather motorbike access despite villa/visitor plan

checklist.question: Verify water availability in February–April or another local driest period, not just monsoon.
checklist.proof: Dry-season source capacity and reliability evidence
checklist.warning: Water currently available only in rainy season

checklist.question: Check legal water-use rights and cost of pipe, pump, storage and filtration.
checklist.proof: Written connection or source agreement and connection estimate
checklist.warning: No lawful year-round water allocation

checklist.question: Ask nearby occupied houses about dry-season supply, outages and backup.
checklist.proof: Independent neighbor interviews; daily supply estimates
checklist.warning: Supplier story conflicts with repeated local shortage reports

checklist.question: Identify voltage and check the exact electric-line alignment and prescribed clearance.
checklist.proof: Utility voltage/corridor assessment and marked survey offset
checklist.warning: Building footprint or safe access conflicts with line corridor

checklist.question: Confirm transformer/capacity, new connection quotation and whether pole shifting is permitted.
checklist.proof: Written NEA connection feasibility and cost
checklist.warning: Connection depends on unapproved pole relocation

checklist.question: Get contour survey, gradient and usable building platform after setbacks.
checklist.proof: Topographic survey and preliminary siting overlay
checklist.warning: Severe slope or insufficient buildable area

checklist.question: Investigate landslide history, soil strength, earth movement and retaining-wall needs.
checklist.proof: Site geotechnical/geological review; adjacent slope inspection
checklist.warning: Active cracks, fresh slips or unstable fills

checklist.question: Map monsoon surface runoff, drains, gullies and lands above/below parcel.
checklist.proof: Drainage flow sketch and rain inspection
checklist.warning: Runoff from uphill land concentrated toward building site

checklist.question: Price retaining walls, terracing, erosion control, septic/soak-pit siting and excavation.
checklist.proof: Independent provisional civil works estimate
checklist.warning: Earthwork and drainage destroy expected savings

checklist.question: Determine whether the land below/next to the plot can lawfully be developed higher.
checklist.proof: Adjacent parcel planning envelope and permitted height review
checklist.warning: Neighbor could block the view and no protection exists

checklist.question: Check view corridor from the proposed finished-floor height, not only current ground level.
checklist.proof: Sightline sections with surveyed neighbor levels
checklist.warning: Expensive view premium based on an unprotected current view

checklist.question: Compare at least three recent nearby sold or documented comparable plots, not only asking prices.
checklist.proof: Area-adjusted valuation and independent local discussions
checklist.warning: Broker's rate far exceeds comparable documented transactions

checklist.question: Calculate total acquisition and build-enabling cost, not just price per ropani.
checklist.proof: Price + tax/registration + broker + retaining + access + water + power
checklist.warning: Total spend exceeds budget after unavoidable site works

checklist.question: Use written payment milestones, refundable conditions and official bank-transfer trail.
checklist.proof: Signed conditional agreement and money receipts
checklist.warning: Non-refundable advance before title, survey and permit checks

checklist.question: Decide private residence versus guest accommodation before paying for location premium.
checklist.proof: Written intended use and legal-use feasibility
checklist.warning: Assuming Airbnb operation automatically permitted

checklist.question: If tourism use is desired, verify lodging permits, fire/wastewater access and operational rules.
checklist.proof: Local approvals and initial operations compliance list
checklist.warning: Tourism assumptions unsupported by permits/services

checklist.question: Check access from Pokhara, weather-season demand, mobile internet and emergency services.
checklist.proof: Travel test and utilities/coverage observation
checklist.ask: On-site inspection and independent market research
checklist.warning: Remote scenic site cannot support desired use

checklist.question: Identify which exact municipality road entry actually touches the parcel; do not assume the Udaune Dhunga–Astam route applies.
checklist.proof: Signed ward/technical-office statement with surveyed road chainage and sketch.
checklist.ask: Ward 6 and rural municipality engineering section
checklist.warning: An unverified road name is used to justify a setback.

checklist.question: Ask the municipality whether the listed 4/5/6 m centreline distance is the final building line or whether an additional ROW-edge building setback applies.
checklist.proof: Written road centreline, reserved area and building-line determination for the Kitta.
checklist.warning: Broker subtracts 1.5 m arbitrarily or ignores centreline entirely.

checklist.question: Request the latest approved Ward 6 building-bylaw pages, four-side setbacks, height limit, FAR and coverage for this Kitta and intended occupancy.
checklist.proof: Current stamped municipal bylaw extract and site-feasibility note.
checklist.warning: Using an online 2018 example or Pokhara Metropolitan bylaw instead of applicable rules.

checklist.question: Check whether a planned dug well or borewell will have legal water abstraction rights and satisfy boundary/water-source restrictions.
checklist.proof: Local approval, well location, aquifer/source evidence and written constraints.
checklist.ask: Municipality water section and qualified water professional
checklist.warning: Only a proposed well is offered as proof of perennial water.

checklist.question: Lay out drinking-water sources, septic tank, soak pit and downslope neighbors together before choosing the villa location.
checklist.proof: Site-specific sanitation design and groundwater / soil infiltration assessment.
checklist.warning: A pit could contaminate a spring or neighbor's well.

checklist.question: For sanitation, evaluate ENPHO's 20 m horizontal / 4 m vertical wastewater-source guidance and 30 m / 4 m soak-pit guidance—not as a substitute for local approval.
checklist.proof: Surveyed locations, slope groundwater flow and engineered separation drawings.
checklist.warning: Sewage design assumes any 1 m property-boundary offset means groundwater is safe.

checklist.question: Ask NEA to identify line owner, actual voltage (230/400 V, 11, 33, 66, 132, 220 or 400 kV) and conductor route.
checklist.proof: NEA written voltage and alignment confirmation.
checklist.ask: NEA distribution or transmission project office
checklist.warning: Voltage guessed from pole height or seller's oral statement.

checklist.question: Request both wire-to-building clearance and separate transmission ROW mapping (if applicable), accounting for maximum wind swing and sag.
checklist.proof: NEA corridor map and engineer-signed no-objection/safety clearance.
checklist.warning: Seller says 2 metres from pole is sufficient for all high-voltage lines.

checklist.question: Do not treat corridor-width examples as universal: confirm whether this actual line has a gazetted or project-specific ROW.
checklist.proof: NEA project corridor plan tied to parcel geometry and Gazette notifications if applicable.
checklist.ask: NEA transmission office / competent land authority
checklist.warning: A 66 kV ROW is casually assumed from conflicting published example widths.

checklist.question: Observe slope faces uphill and downhill for tension cracks, springs, exposed retaining failures and erosion gullies.
checklist.proof: Geological field notes, geo-tagged private photographs and engineer inspection.
checklist.warning: Recent slips or water seepage crossing proposed foundation location.

checklist.question: Determine whether a deep soak pit or septic discharge is feasible in fractured rock, steep terrain or adjacent springs.
checklist.proof: Infiltration/percolation test and stormwater/wastewater design.
checklist.warning: No safe wastewater disposal site remains after grading restrictions.

checklist.question: Obtain official map/field book and compare on-ground monument corners, not just the shared satellite outline.
checklist.proof: Certified Napi parcel map, field book and signed field demarcation.
checklist.warning: The depicted green outline is mistaken for a registered cadastral boundary.

checklist.question: Model future neighbor buildable envelopes and ridge sight-lines from the intended villa's finished-floor height.
checklist.proof: Surveyed elevation sections and parcel/development control information.
checklist.warning: A view premium is assumed to create a legal view easement.

checklist.question: Estimate *net usable building platform*, not just gross ropani, after roads, setbacks, easements, unsafe slope and drainage.
checklist.proof: Surveyed buildable-area diagram with separate excluded-area register.
checklist.warning: An inexpensive gross plot becomes uneconomic once exclusions are mapped.

checklist.question: Ask for written classification of private dwelling versus homestay, short-stay rentals, guest-house/cottage operations.
checklist.proof: Applicable land-use classification, hospitality permissions and service rules.
checklist.warning: Commercial accommodation assumed allowed simply because nearby homestays operate.

checklist.question: Ensure any advance agreement states refund triggers for failed title, road, water, surveying, electricity, slope or permit feasibility checks.
checklist.proof: Lawyer-reviewed conditional deal paper and traceable bank payment proof.
checklist.warning: Non-refundable payment required before public-office clearance.

hard_stop_notices: If ownership/authority or Kitta cannot be verified, do not pay non-refundable advance.
Water supply fails dry-season test or lawful rights: pause.
NEA corridor overlaps usable building footprint: pause.
Unstable slope or unsafe sanitation/soak-pit location: pause.
Municipality cannot give permit feasibility for intended villa/homestay: pause.

interpretation.status_note: All checkboxes record only personal research/asked items on this device. They do not mean official verification. The authoritative project's ten decision gates stay PENDING.
interpretation.source_priority: Current written plot-specific letters from ward/palika, Napi, Malpot and NEA prevail over the general web examples; verify recent amendments and approved municipal by-laws.
